subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) GLH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59b7df687cf6cc6be3d9c20dc216e8efdfc5541947e6a1aea93ada50bab41a51.png] 

Option 2) EJF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0555f4fc567dfaa38c028573ce662b8f5ddd9ad305d3d0363e789a95e41a54b.png] 

Option 3) NSO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e29e164aa5a3844d5679eae1cdc4dcb000bca08b31c73f542d5e67b764eb967.png] 

**Option 4) LQN**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c0f99dc4b491a8da9dd5166b479fe4f14fcf6a00c16fb76f857342f3a642cdd.png] 

Here, 'LQN' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
